# Test fixtures

`adhesion-contract.txt` is a fictional SaaS master subscription agreement written as a take-it-or-leave-it vendor form. It plants all five renewal-and-exit clause types, with the expected tier for each, including one clause that reads two ways and one benign clause for *Know before signing*. It also carries notice obligations, one outside-terms sentence and decoy clauses outside the family that must never become flags. `clean-document.txt` is a one-off fixed-price purchase order with no renewal-and-exit clauses, no notice obligations and no outside terms, so it should produce a clean result. Each text has a JSON sidecar with the labels and a set of questions, some answerable from the text and some not. Load both through `index.ts`. In the scripted model client, build payloads from the sidecar. Routine payment due dates are not labelled as notice obligations: only deadlines for giving notice to keep or use a right are.

Every `sentence` in a sidecar (clauses, notice obligations, outside terms, decoys and answerable questions) appears word for word exactly once in its document, and every exposure fragment is a substring of its own sentence. The texts are already in canonical form: plain ASCII, straight quotes, single spaces, one blank line between paragraphs, LF endings and one trailing newline. If you edit a text or a sidecar, run `npx vitest run tests/fixtures.test.ts`, which enforces these rules.
